sentence_stem: Yesterday it rained all day, so
correct_completion: we stayed at home and watched a film.
full_sentence: Yesterday it rained all day, so we stayed at home and watched a film.
acceptable_variants: we stayed inside and cleaned the house.
we stayed at home and played games.

options.why_wrong: Walking to the park does not follow logically from heavy rain all day. 'So' needs a result that makes sense after the cause.

options.text: we will go to the park tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This uses 'will' (future), but the sentence is about yesterday, so the past simple is needed.

options.text: we stayed at home and watched a film.

options.why_wrong: This describes the park but does not give a result of the rain, so it does not complete the cause-and-result pattern of 'so'.

grammar_focus: Past simple regular verbs (stayed, watched) after 'so'
explanation: 'So' introduces a result: because it rained all day, the speaker stayed at home. The verbs 'stayed' and 'watched' are regular past simple forms made by adding -ed. Turkish speakers may use a present or future form here, but the story is in the past, so the past simple is needed.
translation: Dün bütün gün yağmur yağdı, bu yüzden evde kaldık ve bir film izledik.
